scores.evidence: Critical path: BAA + security review → ExpressRoute provisioning → M2 production replication (14-day soak) → M3 rehearsals + CAB → M4 → M5.
scores.rationale: Phases build from foundations and spikes to replication, rehearsal, app canary, DB cutover, and decommission, with entry gates proving each dependency first.

scores.evidence: Test booking via the pipeline-deployed stack generates an SIU message received by the test engine
scores.rationale: M1 is a real end-to-end slice through the pipeline, but it is non-prod only with masked data, not a production path.

scores.evidence: D2 ... Revisit if: On-prem is older than SQL 2022 and the sponsor needs switch-back after cutover → choose (b).
scores.rationale: Nine decisions have options, rationale, reversibility and flip conditions, and assumptions have defaults, impact and validation dates.

scores.evidence: Week 1 long-lead items (BAA, ExpressRoute, security review), then landing zone, then DB, then app; canary clinics 1 → 10% → 50% → 100%
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items (connectivity, compliance, landing zone, DB decisions) come first, and rollout goes from a pilot clinic outward.

scores.evidence: Security review must pass, and the BAA must be signed, before any production data replicates (entry criterion for M2).
scores.rationale: Security runs through every phase: M1 policy-deny, masked data and Key Vault; M2 entry gate; M3 pen test; M5 audit logging.

scores.evidence: Add non-prod observability: ... synthetic book/cancel script every 60 s, and one alert ... Done when stopping IIS on both VMs triggers the alert
scores.rationale: Observability is built in the M1 thin slice, extended to prod in M2, and used in canary and cutover with concrete metrics and alerts.

scores.evidence: Everything is defined in code (Bicep) ... deployed by pipeline; hardened image; masked dataset script; reconciler scripts in the repo
scores.rationale: IaC, pipelines, hardened images, scripted masking and versioned runbooks and reconciler apply from M1 through cutover.

scores.evidence: M4 app canary: Traffic director moves clinics back to the on-prem pool (also automatic on health failure) ≤ 5 min
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears in every phase: link lag alerts in M2, abort rehearsals in M3, automatic fallback in M4, abort rule and rollback in M5, and the WAN failure flow.

scores.evidence: AI-specific concerns: not applicable. No AI components are involved.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.
